monotonicity_conclusion: Exact construction and strict-holdout steps show strict G decrease can worsen P_edge, A2, boundary squared-radius dispersion, and six-direction boundary imbalance.

small_N_objective_set_separation.statement: At N=6 the unique global G minimizer is one of three global P_edge minimizers, so the minimizer sets are not equal; further set inequality occurs at N=9 and N=11 through N<=12.
